title: Azusawa Kohane — Emu Style? The Art Of Dancing!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Emu Style? The Art Of Dancing!（4★）

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm guessing practice went well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it did! But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's pretty crowded today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Not exactly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: None of us had anything else to do and we all just happened to gather here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Welcome, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane, you're all done with the Fan Festival now, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How'd it go? I really wanna know!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, sure.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, that must've been pretty wild!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It totally was!
Especially since Kohane was in the lineup!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A-An...!
You don't need to exaggerate...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, those two things don't have anything to do with each other.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes, they do!
A ton of people seemed completely blown away by Kohane's singing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You even had this dumb grin on your face probably out of wanting to gloat about her being your teammate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see. So, Toya, did Akito have a smug grin on his face then?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe... Yes, he did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: T-Toya...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's nothing to be ashamed of. You're all on the same team.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's hard not to feel a little embarrassed in front of your closest friends.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can sympathize.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What are you talking about, KAITO? You're just you, no matter where you are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aww, can't you say that a little nicer...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, you guys, that's enough teasing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, also, you performed at the Fan Festival with some friends, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I take it that it ended up being a good experience for all of you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it really was!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We talked about what we work on during our own practices and even exchanged pieces of advice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We even talked a lot about what hobbies we like and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but that always ended up becoming a discussion about songs and music.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds just like you guys.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They really love music too, huh?
I guess it's only natural that your conversations gravitated towards that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like music's given me so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Finding Weekend Garage turned into me meeting you, An, and picking up singing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Music's given me so many new friends too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me being here and meeting all these new friends is also because of you guys, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You pushed me towards wanting to sing, Miku, and you helped me become more outgoing than before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Without all of you, I wouldn't have discovered what my true feelings were, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. We should be thanking you as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your thoughts and feelings are what gave birth to this SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You guys never cease to amaze us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. Seeing all of you work so hard towards reaching the top is really encouraging and heartwarming.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Miku, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just don't give up on surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It won't be easy, but I'm sure you'll be able to as long as you keep doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone here's on our side, so we've totally got this!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it really was!
